prompt:
Use the attached APPROVED Forest Egg sheet as strict reference for ART STYLE, cute faces and CUBE BODY CONSTRUCTION ONLY; all characters are NEW marine creatures, not forest animals. Create ONE LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 concept sheet with EXACTLY FIVE pets: three equal cells on top, two centered below. Same warm cream page, softly tinted themed cells, dark rounded legible captions, soft studio contact shadows and consistent front three-quarter camera. Large title at top. Each pet has its NAME and RARITY below, NO percentages.
ABSOLUTE USER REQUIREMENTS: every pet's entire head+body is ONE SQUARE CUBE with FLAT square front, FLAT horizontal top and vertical flat sides, parallel straight edges and small softly beveled corners. NO separate head, neck, organic torso, snout mass, sphere or oval body. Large expressive glossy eyes LOW on cube front, colored irises with white catchlights, blush and tiny happy mouth; flat face masks directly ON cube. Four tiny stubby paws/flipper feet/tentacle feet directly underneath the cube; no realistic anatomy. Smooth soft toy-plastic surfaces, limited broad forms, same appealing softness as reference. Preserve distinct marine species silhouettes while ALWAYS keeping the cube central mass obvious.
SIMPLE DESIGNS: no leafy collars, kelp costumes, flower accessories, tiny feather/scale detail, fine jewelry, busy little gems or particles. No realistic textures, scenery, underwater backdrop, actual egg, tools, football elements or watermark. One or two bold defining species features, higher rarities get stronger secondary forms and restrained luminous accents, NOT detail clutter. Full appendages inside their own cells. All five names and rarity captions readable. Do not copy a Forest pet.

Title exactly: "KELP EGG".
Theme: sunny shallow sea, sea-glass greens, sand, coral peach. Pale seafoam cell panels.
Top left KELP GUPPY / COMMON: light lime-and-ivory cube fish, gold eyes, two short broad mint side fins and one broad forked mint tail. One simple golden dorsal fin. No plant decorations, fine stripes, fish body taper or projecting fish lips.
Top center SHELL SNAIL / UNCOMMON: coral-peach cube sea snail, big teal eyes on cube FRONT, two short rounded feelers on top, one large simple smooth cream spiral shell rising behind cube, four tiny peach foot nubs. Shell has one broad salmon spiral groove only.
Top right PEBBLE CRAB / RARE: warm sandy-orange cube crab, sea-green eyes on front (not stalks), two large smooth rounded coral pincers held out at sides, four tiny feet directly beneath block. One flat ivory front patch. Only one broad split per pincer, no tiny legs or armor seams.
Bottom left RIBBON SEAHORSE / EPIC: mint-turquoise CUBE seahorse, gold eyes, tiny simple flat smile with no long snout, one soft crown-shaped dorsal fin of just three broad lobes on cube top, two small side fins, one large ivory-tipped curled ribbon tail extending behind cube. Tiny mint foot nubs. A narrow gold rim on dorsal fin and tail, no leafy costume.
Bottom right REEF TURTLE / LEGENDARY: jade-green SINGLE CUBE turtle, ivory flat front face patch, amber eyes. One broad smooth deep emerald shallow shell dome attached over the rear/top of cube, with ONE thick warm ivory-gold rim and one big central hexagon inset, NO many small shell tiles. Two broad sea-glass side flippers and tiny flipper feet. Short tail. Shell rim and flipper tips glow faintly warm gold. Cube front and vertical side remain clear; no protruding turtle head or separate body.

Title exactly: "LEVIATHAN EGG".
Theme: powerful ocean animals, cool blue, turquoise, navy, pearl. Pale aqua-blue cells.
Top left TIDE SHARK / COMMON: slate-blue cube shark, pale ivory flat face patch, big aqua eyes and tiny happy smile, one rounded triangular dorsal fin on top, two short side fins and one forked tail. Four tiny fin feet. No pointed snout or scary teeth.
Top center DEEP MANTA / UNCOMMON: dusty periwinkle CUBE manta ray, gold eyes, two broad smooth triangular fins spread sideways, two tiny curled cephalic nubs beside top front corners, short smooth tail. Four tiny fin feet; the cube is not flattened into a flat ray body.
Top right PEARL NARWHAL / RARE: pearl-ivory cube narwhal with pale cyan side, big lavender eyes, ONE short broad straight ivory tusk projecting diagonally up from top-front center with only one subtle spiral color band, two short navy flippers and small forked tail. Tiny navy fin feet. Cube face unobscured.
Bottom left ROYAL ORCA / EPIC: midnight-navy cube orca, flat ivory face mask and one large white side oval, warm blue eyes, one LARGE sweeping smooth dorsal fin with a pale teal tip, broad short flippers and forked tail. Tiny dark feet. No jewelry or crown.
Bottom right CROWN LEVIATHAN / LEGENDARY: rich teal cube sea serpent, pearl flat face patch, enormous gold eyes, TWO large smooth swept-back teal horns with pearl tips and ONE pair of broad fin-like side frills of only two broad lobes each; one long broad curled tail with a simple gold-edged forked tip. Tiny teal feet. Restrained cyan edge light on frills. No scales, armor, plant costume or separate long serpent neck. Horns suggest a crown silhouette, no actual crown accessory.

Title exactly: "TREASURE EGG".
Theme: pearls, warm sea treasure, copper, turquoise and simple satin-gold accents. Pale cream-gold cells.
Top left COPPER PUFFER / COMMON: soft copper-orange CUBE pufferfish, teal eyes, ivory flat front patch, just FOUR short blunt rounded spike nubs on cube top corners, two tiny side fins, one short forked tail, tiny feet. NO spherical puffer body or forest of spikes.
Top center PEARL CLAM / UNCOMMON: pale pink/ivory cube clam creature with big blue eyes on cube FRONT and tiny smile; two large smooth pale coral scallop-shell fan plates behind cube, each with only three broad lobes. ONE round cream pearl nested between plate tops. Tiny pink feet. Body is a visible cube, not a realistic open mouth or dome.
Top right TREASURE OCTOPUS / RARE: coral-red cube octopus, big gold eyes, ivory flat facial mask, FOUR tiny curled tentacle feet directly underneath plus FOUR short broad side tentacles, total eight. One or two flat gold oval markings on visible side only. No suckers, pirate hats, held treasure or bead necklaces.
Bottom left GILDED HERMIT / EPIC: sea-turquoise CUBE hermit crab, gold eyes, one large smooth GOLD spiral shell rising behind cube with one simple broad groove, two LARGE smooth cream-gold pincers and four tiny turquoise feet. No shell jewels, many tiny legs or crown.
Bottom right TREASURE MIMIC / LEGENDARY: adorable turquoise-and-satin-gold CUBE treasure chest PET. Broad flat cube front has oversized emerald eyes and tiny friendly smile directly on it. One thick gold band follows the top/back and cube edges, one closed dark wood lid seam across the TOP only, ONE large smooth ruby-red gem on lid center. Four tiny gold paws. Body stays one closed cube, no open jaw or teeth, no extra lid-head, pile of coins, weapons, wings, crown or busy ornate hardware. Very restrained warm glint on gold band and ruby, clean bold silhouette.

Title exactly: "ABYSS EGG".
Theme: cute deep-sea creatures, ink-blue, dusky plum, cyan and violet bioluminescence. Pale blue-lavender cells, BRIGHT cream studio page, no dark underwater scene.
Top left LANTERN SHRIMP / COMMON: muted plum CUBE shrimp, warm gold eyes, tiny happy mouth, two thick SHORT curved antennae on top with round cyan tips, one broad tail fan behind, tiny cyan flipper feet. No realistic insect legs or long shrimp abdomen.
Top center INK SQUID / UNCOMMON: dark navy CUBE squid, violet eyes, pale lavender flat face patch, two broad SIMPLE triangular lavender side fins, four short curved purple tentacle feet under cube. One short smooth rear tail nub. No suckers, realistic squid mantle taper or ink particles.
Top right ANGLER CUB / RARE: dark blue CUBE anglerfish, enormous warm yellow eyes and tiny cute smile, ONE short thick smooth curved top stalk ending in a large CYAN glowing bulb, two compact broad fins and short forked tail. Tiny dark-blue feet. No enormous jaw, sharp teeth or horror expression.
Bottom left ABYSS KRAKEN / LEGENDARY: deep violet CUBE kraken, big mint eyes, pale cyan flat face mask. FOUR large broad smooth curling tentacle arms arching at cube sides/behind, plus FOUR tiny curled tentacle feet below, total eight. Cyan tips and one flat cyan oval per big arm, no rows of suckers or jewelry. Core is a clear squat box, arms well separated in silhouette.
Bottom right ABYSS NAUTILUS / SECRET: almost black midnight-teal CUBE nautilus spirit, large luminous ice-blue eyes and tiny smile, FOUR tiny dark tentacle feet. ONE oversized smooth black-teal spiral SHELL behind cube, with ONE continuous broad glowing CYAN spiral stripe wrapping its visible face. Two short smooth side feelers with cyan tips. No multiple shell rings, stars, particles, scales, crowns or floating orbit rings. Front cube edges get faint teal rim light so square planes remain readable. The single glowing shell spiral is the iconic secret silhouette; this is a creature, not a realistic fossil or a round body.

Title exactly: "JELLY EGG".
Theme: soft translucent jellyfish and glassy marine spirits, aqua, peach, pale lilac and pearl. Pale lilac-pink cells. Semi-translucent material ONLY, solid readable flat cube planes and faces; no internal organs or realistic refraction noise.
Top left BUBBLE JELLY / COMMON: pale AQUA semi-translucent CUBE jellyfish, big lavender eyes and tiny smile, flat ivory face mask, four tiny rounded jelly tentacle feet directly underneath. ONE small flat white bubble marking on visible side. No round umbrella bell, tendril forest or floating bubbles.
Top center JELLY SLUG / UNCOMMON: translucent PEACH-PINK CUBE sea slug, big teal eyes ON cube front, two short smooth rounded pink top feelers with ivory tips, one simple broad curled pink tail behind. Four tiny jelly foot nubs. No long body, separate head, leafy gills or actual slime.
Top right GLASS SEAHORSE / RARE: translucent pale ROSE-LILAC CUBE seahorse, gold eyes, tiny smile directly on flat front with NO protruding snout. One top crest with THREE large smooth rounded lobes, two tiny side fins, one broad pale-cyan curled ribbon tail. Four tiny pink feet. One gentle pearly edge highlight, no scales or jewelry.
Bottom left PRISM MANTA / EPIC: translucent SKY-BLUE CUBE manta spirit, big pink-violet eyes, flat ivory face patch, ONE pair of large broad lavender/cyan fins spread outward and ONE short thick curling tail. Four tiny aqua fin feet. Only TWO broad pastel colors on wings, no rainbow stripes, crystals or stars. Keep central cube thick and square, not a flattened real ray.
Bottom right ROYAL MEDUSA / LEGENDARY: luminous pale PERIWINKLE semi-translucent CUBE jellyfish queen, huge gold eyes and tiny smile on ivory flat face patch. ONE small chunky satin-gold crown with just THREE broad points rests on FLAT cube top. FOUR broad softly curling translucent lilac ribbon tentacles from lower corners, ending in cyan tips and serving as short feet; keep them compact enough that cube dominates. Restrained pearly inner glow, no additional dangling tendrils, strings, gemstones, necklaces, leaf outfits or orbiting particles. Crown and four bold jelly ribbons carry the rare silhouette. Entire body remains ONE clearly square block, never a dome or oval jellyfish bell.
